### Phase 19: reuse dequantization matrices across quantizer lanes

`active` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase19-dequant-matrix-reuse/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Remove output-preserving construction work from HfQuantizers: build each default dequantization matrix once per transform and reuse it across the transform's HfMul lanes, while keeping the public single-quantizer constructor and every emitted integer byte-identical. Measure whether this lower-risk cleanup improves the Balanced and Fast target-rate paths before attempting spatial or quality-policy changes.
